description: Transaction rules engine, real transaction endpoints, USSD state machine endpoint, SMS inbound/outbox endpoints, panic endpoint, login-guard endpoint, scam library endpoint. Also adds PATCH /accounts/me to auth router. FEAT-003 depends on FEAT-001 (models, auth) and FEAT-002 (scan endpoint, run_rules). The transaction rules import from engine/transaction_rules.py (no FastAPI) and call DB queries. All new routers replace their FEAT-001 stubs.
steps:
1. Create backend/engine/transaction_rules.py. No FastAPI imports. TxnSignal = dataclass(code:str, triggered:bool, weight:int). ProposedTransaction = dataclass(recipient:str, amount:Decimal, currency:str, country:str). TxnRiskResult = dataclass(score:int, tier:str, reasons:list[str], advice:list[str]). Load transaction_reason_codes and advice_by_transaction_reason from shared/reason_codes.json (absolute path via __file__). Implement 6 check functions (all take proposed:ProposedTransaction, history:list, recent_scans:list):
- check_new_recipient: triggered if proposed.recipient not in {t.recipient for t in history if t within 90 days}
- check_unusual_amount: triggered if history>=3 sends and proposed.amount > 2 * mean(amounts of last 90d sends)
- check_round_large_amount: triggered if proposed.amount >= 500 and proposed.amount % 100 == 0
- check_rapid_repeat_sends: triggered if count of sends to same recipient in last 24h >= 3
- check_after_risky_message: triggered if any ScanResult in recent_scans has tier='HIGH_RISK' and created_at >= utcnow()-30min
- check_new_country: triggered if proposed.country not in {t.country for t in history}
check_transaction(proposed, history, recent_scans) -> TxnRiskResult: run all 6, collect triggered signals, score = min(100, sum of triggered weights), determine tier, trim reasons to top 3, look up advice from advice_by_transaction_reason for highest-weight triggered reason.

2. Replace backend/routers/transactions.py stub with real implementation. POST /transactions/check (auth required): query user's Transaction history (last 90 days), query ScanResult for last 30 min (tier=HIGH_RISK), run check_transaction, return TransactionCheckResponse. POST /transactions/send (auth required): run check_transaction first; if tier=HIGH_RISK and not request.force: return 422 with error body; otherwise: if session.is_duress create Transaction(is_decoy=True, status='decoy'); else create real Transaction(is_decoy=False, status='completed'); return SendResponse. GET /transactions/history (auth required): if session.is_duress return generate_decoy_account(user_id)['recent_transactions'] as TransactionHistoryResponse; else query real transactions with limit/offset.

3. Create backend/routers/panic.py (replace stub). POST /panic (auth required): set session.is_duress=True, write AuditLog(event_type='panic_triggered', detail={'timestamp': now}), if user.trusted_contact: create SMSMessage(user_id=user.id, direction='outbound', body=f'Mukuru Detection: Emergency mode was activated on your contact\'s account at {now}. Please check on them.', sender='MukuruAlert'), return {status:'ok'}.

4. Create backend/routers/login_guard.py (replace stub). POST /login-guard/event (auth required): accept LoginGuardRequest(event_type:str, answer:str|None=None) from backend/schemas/login_guard.py. If answer is None: return {checkin_question: 'Has someone you met online asked you for money?', status: 'awaiting_answer'}. If answer=='yes': set user.login_guard_alert_until = utcnow() + 60min, write AuditLog(event_type='login_guard_alert'), return {status:'risk_raised', advice:['TRUST_YOUR_INSTINCTS','DO_NOT_PAY_UPFRONT','BLOCK_AND_REPORT'], explanation: 'This is a common romance scam pattern. People met online who quickly ask for money are almost always scammers.'}. If answer=='no': return {status:'ok', advice:[]}. Also update check_after_risky_message in engine/transaction_rules.py to also trigger when any ScanResult in recent_scans with tier HIGH_RISK OR when recent_scans contains a synthetic 'login_guard_active' sentinel passed from the router.

5. Create backend/schemas/login_guard.py — LoginGuardRequest(event_type:str, answer:str|None=None). Update backend/routers/transactions.py POST /transactions/check to also check user.login_guard_alert_until: if it's set and > utcnow(), inject a synthetic recent HIGH_RISK scan into the recent_scans list passed to check_transaction. This makes AFTER_RISKY_MESSAGE trigger even without a prior scan.

6. Create backend/routers/library.py (replace stub). GET /scams/library (no auth): accept lang:str=Query(default='en'), category:str|None=Query(default=None). Load data/scam_library.json from absolute path (os.path.join project root). For each entry, if category filter provided, filter; return entries as-is (red_flags and advice are already codes from reason_codes.json). The router does NOT translate — it returns codes; the client translates with i18n.

7. Implement backend/routers/sms.py (replace stub). POST /sms/inbound: accept SmsInboundRequest. Look up user by from_number (query User table). Parse body: if body.strip()=='1': fetch user's last ScanResult, format as '{tier} - {top_reason}. {top_advice}' truncated to 160 chars (120 for Hindi); else if body.upper().startswith('SCAM '): run scan on remainder via run_rules, format result; else if body.upper()=='HELP': return help text. Write SMSMessage(direction='inbound', sender=from_number, body=body) and reply SMSMessage(direction='outbound', sender='MukuruAlert', body=reply_text). Return {status:'received', reply:reply_text}. GET /sms/outbox (auth required): return paginated SMSMessage list for current user where direction='outbound'.

8. Implement backend/routers/ussd.py (replace stub). POST /ussd: accept both application/x-www-form-urlencoded and application/json. Parse sessionId, serviceCode, phoneNumber, text. All state derived from text parameter (split on '*'). State machine (see design §7 and requirements §1.3.2-1.3.3): text=='' -> 'CON Welcome to Mukuru Detection
1. New user
2. Log in'. text=='1' -> new user flow: 'CON Enter your phone number:'. text=='1*{phone}' -> 'CON Enter your PIN:'. text=='1*{phone}*{pin}' -> 'CON Enter duress PIN (different):'. text=='1*{phone}*{pin}*{dpin}' -> register or prompt for confirmation. text=='2' -> 'CON Enter your phone number:'. text=='2*{phone}' -> 'CON Enter your PIN:'. text=='2*{phone}*{pin}' -> authenticate (normal or duress); show 'CON Main Menu
1. Check a message
2. Scam examples
3. My account
4. Change language
5. Exit'. text=='2*{phone}*{pin}*1' -> 'CON Paste the message to check:'. text=='2*{phone}*{pin}*1*{msg}' -> run scan on msg, return 'END HIGH RISK: {reason}. {advice}' or SAFE/CAUTION. text=='2*{phone}*{pin}*3' -> fetch account (real or decoy), return 'END Balance: {bal}
Last send: {amount} to {recipient}'. text=='2*{phone}*{pin}*5' -> 'END Thank you. Stay safe!'. All screen text looked up from i18n/{lang}.json using the ussd.* keys. Truncate to 160 characters. Return plain text, not JSON.

9. Create backend/tests/test_transaction_rules.py. Tests: AFTER_RISKY_MESSAGE triggers with HIGH_RISK scan in past 30 min; NEW_RECIPIENT triggers for unknown recipient; UNUSUAL_AMOUNT triggers at >2x 90-day average; RAPID_REPEAT_SENDS triggers at 3 same-recipient sends in 24h; NEW_COUNTRY triggers for unseen country; duress send creates decoy=True Transaction and does not modify existing real balance. All pure unit tests — call check_transaction() directly without HTTP. Include an integration test via httpx TestClient: send in duress mode, confirm HTTP 200 and is_decoy=True in DB.
acceptance_criteria: POST /transactions/check with Blessing's seeded HIGH_RISK scan active returns AFTER_RISKY_MESSAGE in reasons
POST /panic marks session is_duress=True and creates AuditLog row
POST /login-guard/event with answer=yes sets user.login_guard_alert_until and returns risk_raised
POST /ussd with text='2*+27831234567*1234*1*<fake_job_sms>' returns END with HIGH RISK
GET /scams/library returns entries with red_flags codes all present in shared/reason_codes.json
